IBM will pay a monthly base rent of Rs 2.49 crore, subject to a 15% escalation every three years. Additionally, the company will incur fit-out costs over five years, approximately amounting to Rs 179 crore.

Indian investigators, however, have privately told companies the reduced rate does not apply to bulk Scotch concentrates, creating the first significant dispute over the free trade agreement since it took effect.

items.summary: Silver has fallen ₹56,000 from its August peak, and gold has also declined sharply as higher yields reduce the appeal of non-yielding assets. Middle East tensions have pushed oil prices higher, adding to inflation concerns and uncertainty over the Federal Reserve’s next move.

items.summary: In its report, SBI said the RBI had consistently signalled its commitment to monetary tightening through its policy resolution, the Governor’s statement and the minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC). items.summary: Aditya Birla Real Estate Ltd has announced plans to develop a housing project in Pune. This initiative will generate an estimated revenue of Rs 1,650 crore through a Joint Development Agreement. The project, located in Hinjewadi, spans 5.62 acres and features a total saleable area of approximately 1.25 million sq ft. Birla Estates, a subsidiary of Aditya Birla Real Estate, will oversee the project development.

items.summary: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Governor Sanjay Malhotra on Friday said the central bank does not target any specific exchange rate or level for the rupee against the US dollar, stressing that its primary objective is to ensure orderly conditions in the foreign exchange market and prevent excessive volatility.

items.summary: Welspun Corp shares fell 1.75% to ₹2,391.80 on Friday despite winning a ₹5,500-crore US gas pipeline order. The contract, scheduled for execution in 2028-29, lifts the company’s global order book to a record USD 5.25 billion.

items.title: Goa rationalises aviation turbine fuel VAT to 7% from October 24, IndiGo welcomes move
items.summary: Goa government has announced a reduction in the value-added tax on aviation turbine fuel to 7%. This revised VAT rate will come into effect on October 24, 2026. IndiGo welcomed this decision, encouraging other states to implement similar measures. The airline believes this change will enhance air travel accessibility and boost the tourism sector in Goa. The notification amends the Goa Value Added Tax Act to reflect this new rate.

items.title: SBI Cards Q2 profit jumps 75% YoY to Rs 778 crore as bad loan costs fall sharply
items.summary: SBI Cards reported a 75% year-on-year profit increase to Rs 778 crore in Q2 FY27, driven by lower credit costs and improved asset quality. However, corporate card spending declined, receivables contracted, and net interest margins narrowed.

items.title: PLFS set for fresh overhaul, govt seeks public & expert opinion on upcoming new things
items.summary: The National Statistics Office (NSO), which has conducted the PLFS since 2017, plans to introduce the modifications from January 2027, when fresh samples for the 2027-2028 two-year period, designated Panel 6, will be drawn using an updated sampling frame.

items.title: Satellite lights, Google searches cut state growth estimation errors by up to 62%: RBI study
items.summary: RBI study indicates that combining night-time light data with Google search trends can improve state economic growth estimates. Researchers tested their model in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Karnataka, showing significant reductions in forecasting errors. This framework could help provide timely economic insights, as state data is often delayed. Night-time illumination proved to be a strong predictor of Gross State Value Added growth.

items.title: Why US stocks are falling: Dow Jones crashes over 700 points as AI selloff, SpaceX fears hit markets
items.summary: US stocks experienced a decline as AI related shares continued to selloff significantly over the week. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell markedly, affecting overall investor sentiment in the market. Concerns regarding competition from SpaceX led to drops in major telecom stocks such as AT&T and Verizon. Meanwhile, energy stocks achieved record highs as oil prices rose amid ongoing supply concerns.

items.title: Bharat Electronics among 4 Sensex stocks to hit 52-week lows; shares fall up to 9% in a month
items.summary: Four Sensex stocks, including Bharat Electronics, NTPC, Power Grid Corporation and Hindustan Unilever, touched fresh 52-week lows on Friday as the benchmark index declined. The four stocks have fallen between about 6% and 9% over the past month, reflecting continued weakness in their share prices.

items.title: Dr Reddy’s Q2 Results: Net profit falls 36% YoY to Rs 913 crore, revenue declines marginally
items.summary: Dr Reddy’s Laboratories reported a 36% year-on-year profit decline to Rs 913.4 crore in Q2 FY27, while revenue slipped 1.5%. North America weakness pressured performance, offset partly by growth in India and emerging markets, alongside biosimilar approvals and strategic partnerships.

items.title: Inflation stays high, growth slows, central bankers face a bigger challenge, says RBI Guv Malhotra
items.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra highlighted the challenges faced by central banks due to global uncertainties and supply chain issues. He noted the elevated global inflation and lower growth forecasts impacting monetary policy decisions worldwide. India entered this phase with strong macroeconomic fundamentals, maintaining growth at 7.8% despite rising inflation levels. The RBI's goal remains to achieve price stability while ensuring financial market order and health.

items.title: India eyes 30 million tonnes fish output in 5 years, seafood exports of Rs 1.25 lakh crore
items.summary: India has initiated a national action plan for inland small-scale fisheries to increase fish production. The plan aims to achieve a target of 30 million tonnes over the next five years. It will focus on improving livelihoods and sustainability amid climate change challenges. Stakeholder consultations will be conducted to finalise the plan, which covers diverse aquatic ecosystems.

items.title: Banks see ₹5.19 lakh crore deposit outflow, credit shrinks ₹2.52 lakh crore
items.summary: Kolkata's banking sector faced a Rs 5.19 lakh crore withdrawal of deposits in the fortnight ending October 15. Credit outstanding also contracted by Rs 2.52 lakh crore during the same period. Consequently, credit growth decreased to 18.2% from 19.4% in the prior fortnight. Meanwhile, deposit growth recorded a decline to 16.7% compared to 17.8%. The overall outstanding deposits reached Rs 278.76 lakh crore and outstanding credit was Rs 227.

items.title: Chennai-bound IndiGo flight returns to bay at Delhi airport after threat message
items.summary: An IndiGo flight from Delhi to Chennai received a threat message before takeoff and returned to the bay. The Air Traffic Controller received a call alerting them about the threat concerning flight 6E 6091. A message was discovered in a lavatory instructing not to fly the aircraft. Following protocol, the plane was taken to an isolation bay for safety checks.

items.title: IIIT-Bangalore, Poland’s AGH University sign MoU for academic, research collaboration
items.summary: The agreement covers joint research activities, development of academic programmes, exchange of academic materials and mobility opportunities for faculty members and students.

items.title: RBI tightens leverage ratio rules, keeps minimum capital thresholds unchanged
items.summary: The RBI has tightened how banks calculate leverage by widening the measurement of derivatives, repo transactions and off-balance-sheet exposures, while retaining the minimum ratios at 4% for systemically important banks and 3.5% for others. The norms, effective April 1, 2027, also strengthen disclosure requirements and restrict the use of collateral and netting to reduce reported exposures.

items.title: Titan Company brand Zoya seeks to cash in on rising high-end jewellery demand, eyes ₹500 crore revenue by FY27
items.summary: Titan Company's luxury brand Zoya aims to reach ₹500 crore in revenue by FY27 as India's luxury jewellery market expands. It is targeting high-net-worth individuals who seek exclusive and unique jewellery pieces over traditional options. Zoya specialises in coloured gemstones, offering intricate craftsmanship and a range of prices to appeal to affluent consumers.

items.title: Adani Power CEO puts Q2 numbers in perspective, gives a peek into the road ahead
items.summary: Adani Power CEO Khyalia said that the company remained focused on delivering reliable, high-quality electricity on schedule to meet India’s rising baseload requirements. India’s growing appetite for electricity is strengthening the case for thermal power, he added.

Branches of global systemically important banks will also have specific requirements. Feedback from banks was reviewed and modifications were made before finalizing the rules.

The 2036 bond yield rose to 7.4740%, indicating a broader trend of increasing yields. These developments may significantly affect India's import bill and inflation outlook.
